Aaj avoid karke kal ki responsibility se bhaag nahi sakte.
Jitni mehnat karo, utni luck milti hai.
"Success ya failure mindset pe depend."
Mind hi sab kuch—jaisa sochte ho, vaisa bante ho.
Jitni mushkil jung, utni shandaar jeet.
"Character destiny banata."
